title: Administrator Login Bypass
impact: The login form allowed authentication as the administrator without knowing the password.
remediation: Use parameterized SQL queries and validate input on the server.

title: UNION-Based User Data Extraction
payload_used: qwert')) UNION SELECT id,email,'EXTRACTED',4,5,6,7,8,9 FROM Users--
impact: The product search endpoint exposed user IDs and email addresses from the Users table.
remediation: Use parameterized queries and restrict database access to necessary data.

title: Reflected XSS in Order Tracking
impact: The tracking ID parameter executed injected JavaScript in the browser.
remediation: Apply context-appropriate output encoding and sanitize untrusted HTML.

title: Stored XSS in Registered Users
impact: A stored user email payload executed JavaScript when the administration page displayed registered users.
remediation: Validate stored inputs and safely encode user-controlled content when rendering it.
